root_cause: The login route is intentionally noindex and should stay outside sitemap/indexable SEO inventory, but the technical SEO link validator assumed every internal destination must itself be an indexable canonical route. The missing concept was an explicit public utility-route class: valid internal destination, intentionally non-indexable.
prevention: Model public utility routes explicitly as valid internal destinations outside sitemap/indexable SEO inventory.
Do not index authentication/login utility pages merely to satisfy internal-link validation.
Technical SEO may exempt only explicitly classified utility destinations; unknown non-indexable targets remain failures.
Keep utility-route classification in the shared route contract and guard it with executable regression.
